How it works

From first email to hand-over.

Six steps. You see it before it is yours.

  1. 1

    Tell us about your business

    Email your business name, trade and the look you like.

  2. 2

    See a demo first

    A concept before we build. If it is not right, we try another.

  3. 3

    We build your site

    You get a preview.

  4. 4

    You approve it

    Tell us what to adjust.

  5. 5

    Hand-over

    The code goes to your GitHub. The domain and hosting are yours.

  6. 6

    Fixes later, quoted per job

    Need a change? We quote it, fix it, send it back.

Common questions

Questions we hear first.

Is there a monthly fee?

No. One fee. Domain and hosting costs go to your providers.

Who owns the website?

You do. After hand-over we keep no connection to it.

Can I see it before I decide?

Yes. A demo first, then a preview.

What if something breaks later?

Tell us. We quote the fix.

Can you add a form, bookings or a shop?

Yes, as extras quoted per business.

What if I have no logo?

We set your name as a text logo.

Do I have to send photos?

No. Send what you have.

Which languages?

English only, for now.
